name: check-your-advisor
description: 查导师：选导师前查一下课题组。For checking a PhD advisor's lab before you join.

plugins.name: check-your-advisor
plugins.description: 选导师前查课题组用的。输入导师名字，从 PubMed 和 OpenAlex 找出导师的论文，算出学生多久能发第一篇一作、一作主要给了谁、一般待几年，生成中英文报告。什么学科都能查。Looks up a PhD advisor's papers in PubMed and OpenAlex and works out how long students wait for a first-author paper, who gets them, and how long people stay.
